description: The readings of an ambiguity that elision-only finds have the spans and sources of the original input: a node that covers a written-back terminator does not take that terminator's source (engine §7). The second stage emits X[1,1) Y[0,0) Z[1,1) for `a` and X[2,2) Y[1,1) Z[2,2) for `b`, so X Y ends before it starts. In both readings, s covers only the first Y, so its source is [0,0), and the elided KU is at [1,1).

documents.a.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text (letter letter)
%rule letter char %emits $ :: A, $ :: A
%rule char "a" | "b"
```
documents.b.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text (pair pair)
%rule pair (prefix edge)
%rule prefix A %emits ε :: X
%rule edge ($n:nothing A) %emits ε :: Y, $n :: Z
%rule nothing ε
```
documents.c.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy elision-only
%rule text (X s Z triple)
%rule s ([+KU] Y) | ([+KU] q)
%rule q Y
%rule triple (X Y Z)
```
